title: PhysMAP: physics-aware credibility checks for AI surrogates
description: PhysMAP screens machine-learned surrogates used in multiphysics simulation for failures an input-based out-of-distribution detector cannot see. It reads the variables a surrogate never had as inputs, tests the closure relation behind the surrogate against its validated range, and knows at setup which of those variables the detectors can see (closure validity and surrogate observability). As a separate preview it asks whether a mechanism outside the surrogate's calibration is large enough to matter for the quantity of interest (causal materiality).
